name: @tol/attribution
description: Relationship claim scoring + dispute path (the spec). One of the four business-invariant packages named on the spec. earlier (P10): a deterministic, explainable four-factor scoring engine — HISTORY (40%) + PROXIMITY (30%) + EVIDENCE (20%) + TIME (10%), the spec's own weights verbatim — plus a ranking function for competing claims. Zero runtime dependencies, same discipline as @tol/domain/@tol/authz/@tol/crypto. Pure, zero-DB — apps/api's claims module (this stage) is the only consumer of the persisted form.
